title: Four-year post-loading results of full-arch rehabilitation with immediate placement and immediate loading implants: A retrospective controlled study
authors: Simonpieri A, Gasparro R, Pantaleo G, Mignogna J, Riccitiello F, Sammartino G. Quintessence Int. 2017, 48(4):315-324.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxgraft granules (processed human allograft) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Within their limits, the present results suggest that rehabilitatio n with platform switching and taper connection implants, in addition to buccal bone augmentation and the use of PRF, can lead to predictable results” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
